title: Electrical Design Engineer & Machine Safety Specialist (M/F)
description: Join us in driving connectivity forward! At One Mobility Group , we bridge worlds—combining nearly a century of German automotive engineering precision with the innovation power of the globe's largest electronics and ICT manufacturer. This unique positioning makes us the strategic partner for end-to-end mobility solutions—from initial concept design to large-scale manufacturing. Our comprehensive portfolio spans the full spectrum of electrified mobility, including power distribution systems, high- and low-voltage modules, safety components, and advanced charging solutions. We specialize in integration expertise that seamlessly connects data, power, and sensing – redefining what’s possible in intelligent, connected mobility. At One Mobility , you will join a vibrant international team of 10,500 people, working together in 17 countries across Europe, Asia, North America, the Middle East, and Africa. Step into a culture where inclusivity is the foundation, where your ideas are trusted and supported, your passions are nurtured, and the spirit of collaboration is encouraged. We move fast, think differently, and empower our people to deliver breakthrough solutions. We are looking for an Electrical Design Engineer & Machine Safety Specialist (M/F) for our site located in Masevaux (68290), France. Your missions: Take the next step in your carrer within an innovative and international automotive environment : Design and update electrical schematics using SEE Electrical, as well as the associated technical documentation. Define electrical architectures, prepare bills of materials (BOMs), and draft technical specifications for suppliers. Participate in the selection and standardization of electrical components, automation systems, safety equipment, and industrial networks. Monitor electrical installations, verify wiring compliance, and support assembly, testing, and commissioning activities. Validate equipment supplied by external vendors through technical reviews, FAT/SAT procedures, and compliance checks. Perform risk assessments and define machine safety architectures in accordance with applicable standards. Conduct Performance Level (PL) calculations using SISTEMA and verify the compliance of safety functions. Contribute to CE marking activities and ensure the regulatory compliance of equipment. Support the continuous improvement of technical standards and maintain up-to-date technical documentation. Education: Bachelor’s degree (2 to 5 years of higher education) in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field. Experience: Proven experience in the electrical design of special-purpose machines or industrial equipment. Experience in managing technical projects and ensuring installation compliance. Technical Skills: Strong expertise in the design and development of electrical schematics. Good knowledge of industrial equipment, automated systems, and technical validation processes. Ability to analyze and verify the technical compliance of supplier deliverables. Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of machine safety requirements and associated regulations. Ability to ensure compliance with company standards and technical specifications. Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners. Capable of working independently while maintaining a collaborative team-oriented approach. Problem Solving: Analytical mindset and strong sense of responsibility. Ability to identify technical gaps, propose improvement solutions, and implement sustainable corrective actions while ensuring compliance with company standards. Languages: Fluency in French is required, and a good command of technical English is necessary to work effectively in an international environment. Our offer: Corporate benefits program with many attractive offers Globally operating group of companies Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes Contract type: Permanent contract Are you interested?
